snippet.title: Blocks for Babies - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description:
Classic block-stacking, now with a shotgun. Jump between first-person carnage and 2D puzzle action to clear away blocks in this unique hybrid roguelike. Every kill shapes the game board, so pick up a gun and start making precious childhood memories.

Blocks for Babies will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
